integrity: The proof reconstructs the coloring equations, uses the published affine classification of all dihedral-quandle endomorphisms, and computes the orbit blocks symbolically via projective difference classes and the Chinese remainder theorem. The bundled finite replay checks p=5,7,11 only as a regression.
scientific_limitations: The result gives a rigorous infinite counterfamily and an exact repair on P(p,p,p) with R_{2p}, but does not classify the full composite-modulus parameter space of the source theorem.
title: An infinite composite-modulus counterfamily to the pretzel quiver formula
